title: [ 숙제 ] 음식 타입별, 연령별 주문건수 pivot view 만들기
markdown: ### [ 숙제 ] 음식 타입별, 연령별 주문건수 pivot view 만들기 --- ### 1. 음식 타입 및 연령대에 따른 주문 수 집계 SQL ```sql select a.cuisine_type, case when age between 10 and 19 then 10 when age between 20 and 29 then 20 when age between 30 and 39 then 30 when age between 40 and 49 then 40 when age between 50 and 59 then 50 end age, count(1) cnt_order from food_orders a inner join customers b on a.customer_id = b.customer_id where age between 10 and 59 group by 1, 2 order by 2 ``` 실행 결과 ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/ae379ba3db9279e04fd12befb1b757091fbdbcb5/posts/1baeda9b-0fe1-80d5-8b85-c8e23b6336af/4647e13d941801bf.webp) ### 2. pivot table ```sql select cuisine_type, max(if(age=10, cnt_order, 0)) "10대", max(if(age=20, cnt_order, 0)) "20대", max(if(age=30, cnt_order, 0)) "30대", max(if(age=40, cnt_order, 0)) "40대", max(if(age=50, cnt_order, 0)) "50대" from ( select a.cuisine_type, case when age between 10 and 19 then 10 when age between 20 and 29 then 20 when age between 30 and 39 then 30 when age between 40 and 49 then 40 when age between 50 and 59 then 50 end age, count(1) cnt_order from food_orders a inner join customers b on a.customer_id = b.customer_id where age between 10 and 59 group by 1, 2 ) t group by 1 ``` ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gyungsubLee/subdev-blog-content/ae379ba3db9279e04fd12befb1b757091fbdbcb5/posts/1baeda9b-0fe1-80d5-8b85-c8e23b6336af/4d5f7a32d8431810.webp)
